verified_contract_requirements: delivery revalidates verifier provenance and unchanged contract fields
downstream consumers revalidate the live verifier provenance at point of use
direct or exact-class forged contracts are unmountable
duplicate_rule: same effect_id, destination, and payload_root returns ALREADY_ACCEPTED with the original receipt root
collision_rules: same effect_id with a different payload_root rejects
same effect_id with a different destination rejects
effect adapter_profile_root must equal the verified contract profile
records are unique and sorted by effect_id
nested destination-record fields are revalidated at every state boundary
a new effect at exact capacity rejects without changing state
an exact-class forged contract cannot enter a downstream consumer
unmountable_rule: unsupported mechanism or forged contract root cannot produce a verified contract witness
nonclaims: no acknowledgment provenance or lost-ack recovery
no production adapter or runtime mounting
